title: C1/C2: measure whether the target probes its environment (hostname, date, ls /, network, git log) as a behavioural eval-awareness signal in sandbox runs
body: Idea from the sponsor-use review (Modal). Real tools make a third measure possible next to A1 (judge reads reasoning) and A2 (is-this-synthetic AUROC): does the target check its surroundings? Log every sandbox command and classify the ones that inspect the environment rather than do the task (hostname, whoami, date, uname, ls / or ~, env, network checks, reading git log or config to see if it is real). Report the probing rate per transcript and its correlation with A1 and A2, and validate the classifier on hand-labelled transcripts before using it as a metric. Depends on modal-sandbox-tools. Scoring changes touch nathan-c's measure.py: coordinate with him.
